findings.summary: `rename` fetches the document via `self.repo.get(doc_id)` without an ownership check (`user_id` unused), letting any authenticated user rename another user's document (IDOR/authorization bypass).

judge.reason: Same defect: rename uses repo.get without ownership check, allowing renaming others' documents.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: Skipping the `_owned` check also skips the `NotFound` response for non-owned documents, so callers can learn which doc ids exist, violating the documented no-id-disclosure guarantee.

judge.reason: Describes the missing _owned check leading to id existence disclosure, which is part of the same bug.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: `rename` validates the title before checking ownership, so a non-owner with an invalid title gets `ValueError` instead of `NotFound`; error ordering is inconsistent with other methods.

judge.reason: Ordering complaint is a side effect; the real defect is missing ownership check entirely, and this claims a different wrong behavior.

findings.label: false_alarm
